The Nuggets (0-1) host the Pelicans (0-2) in Denver's second game of the 2026-27 season. Denver sits 11th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, while New Orleans is 10th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back.

Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee).

The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
